evidence.detail: Rows, one per transition: ac1/item-complete (the backlog organ's complete: nothing is sent by the commit itself; the pass sends ticket ended once for both units of the item; the scratch of both goes; the clean worktree goes after its build output and after the keep step, with the kept ref in the main repository at its commit and the branch still there; a second pass sends nothing), ac1/item-cancel (the backlog organ's cancel: the scratch goes; the worktree with an untracked file is deferred as unique_work, the file byte for byte, with no keep step run), ac1/unit-dispose-unit (the scratch goes; the worktree whose branch holds a commit no other ref holds is deferred as unique_work with the commit on its branch; the item stays open and its other unit is not ended), ac1/assignment-close (the unit's scratch goes; its open sibling's scratch stays), ac1/other-ticket-untouched, ac1/closed-unit-authorized-later (an authorization recorded on a unit a close had ended, and a later record of another command that writes an ended item, send nothing and judge nothing again), ac1/record-names-transition-and-command (the observation log and each removal and deferral record name the transition and the command that committed it).

The rows run the real Service on a real SQLite store with OpenSSH journal and command signatures; every journal record is signed by the service's own sign. The project's cancel, complete, pause and resume and the backlog item's complete and cancel are the real organs' own signed commands on that connection. The space Ledger is on the same store, with Signal, the kind registry, the probes, the removers and the keeper, which really delete; each project is in act mode by the owner's own signed command; every worktree is a real linked worktree made with plain git. The disk, git and the ledger are read as each pass returns. Stand-ins: assumptions 1 to 6.

THE CONSOLE'S ROUTE IS BUILT TO THE AUTHORITY, NOT TO A SCREEN. space.abandon is a write route of control_api.py with its operation in the assertion and its dispatch in the API authority; rows f3/* drive the real authority with edge-signed assertions, and suite 71_veldo_0130 holds the route to its handler, its operation and its command. 2. THE PROVISIONER DOES NOT CALL space_provisioned YET. VELDO-0302 now carries the criterion (AC4). The rows call the entry directly, before the new worktree's item is confirmed.

3. NOTHING BUILDS Service.space YET. VELDO-0315 now carries the criterion (AC7). The suite gives the service its ledger; until that wiring lands an installation sends nothing and the route answers unavailable_service:space_ledger. A service that starts reads the journal from its head: an end committed while no service ran waits for reconcile.

4. THE UNIT'S dispose_unit AND THE ASSIGNMENT'S CLOSE ARE STAND-IN RECORDS: journal records a fixture command commits on the real store, holding the entities control_backlog._dispose_unit and control_assignment._dispose_changes write, signed by the service. The real commands need the owner's settled answer through the settlement chain. NOT PROVEN HERE: those two against the real organs. The units, the items and their authorized alternative outcomes are fixture records.

5. THE OWNER'S KEEP IS A MARK, AND NOTHING WRITES IT YET FROM THE OWNER'S ANSWER. The ledger state kept is also what Signal writes for a table action that removes nothing, so the owner's Keep is the item's owner_keep mark, written by the outcome kept that carries it. Since fix round 2 the ledger writes it, and ends it, only for a command whose principal its own membership names as the owner, and the suite writes it as that owner, in two commands (a signal that names the item, then the outcome). NOT PROVEN HERE, and VELDO-0318 AC4 as amended in this round: the owner's signature over the Keep (an in-process caller that names the owner as its principal is still believed by the ledger; the Abandon's signature is the edge's, checked by the API authority), the single command from deferred to kept, and that an owner's answer Keep sets the mark. Design 6.1's signal row still says kept items are signalled; section 0 holds and the row is the lead's to amend.
